title: Privacy
summary: A privacy-preserving synthetic data generation web application with a FastAPI backend that lets users generate and evaluate synthetic tabular/relational data. The generator module directly instantiates SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE and HMA1 synthesizers alongside its Metadata class, and its evaluators call sdv.metrics.tabular and rdt.HyperTransformer for quality and privacy assessment, making SDV the core engine of the tool.
evidence: generator.py:4-9 imports GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE, HMA1, Metadata from sdv; evaluators/sdveval.py uses sdv.metrics.tabular
